entities.summary: Global Studies (GS) or global affairs (GA) is the interdisciplinary study of global macro-processes. Predominant subjects are political science in the form of global politics, as well as economics, law, the sociology of law, ecology, environmental studies, geography, sociology, culture, anthropology and ethnography. It distinguishes itself from the related discipline of international relations by its comparatively lesser focus on the nation state as a fundamental analytical unit, instead focusing on the broader issues relating to cultural and economic globalisation, global power structures, as well of the effect of humans on the global environment.

historicalSignificance.significanceNarrative: Global Studies' focus on global macro-processes and its comparative emphasis on cultural and economic globalization distinguishes it from international relations. This shift in perspective has significant implications for our understanding of global power structures and the impact of human activity on the environment.
